title: Ren and Stimpy Show #7 Marvel Comics 1993 Kid Stimpy Boxing Cover Nickelodeon
conditionDescription: Bright cover with light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
The Ren & Stimpy Show #7 (June 1993), Marvel Comics - "Kid Stimpy": Stimpy in the boxing ring with Ren as his manager ("You eediot! You're supposed to heet back!"). Mike Kazaleh cover. X-Men 30th anniversary corner box. $1.75 cover price.

Back cover: TSR Dragon Month "Take the Challenge!" ad.

Condition: bright with light handling wear (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
